melee.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Production painted dark fantasy 2D game sprite sheet, matching the attached approved character. Keep same costume, identity, proportions and rear three-quarter camera facing RIGHT in EVERY cell. TRUE transparent background, no text, no grid lines, no shadows on ground, no magic, no streaks or effects baked into character. EXACTLY 9 separate full-body figures in a strict 3 columns by 3 rows square sheet (prefer 2048x2048). One equal-sized cell per pose. Broad clear transparent gutters, all weapon tips and capes fully inside each cell, nothing touches adjacent cells. Same head size and scale across every pose, feet on common baseline within each row. Not nine different people: a coherent animation sequence. Reaver: closed steel helmet, bronze-steel plate armour, ONE full continuous deep crimson cape covering the entire back down to the calves, not ragged strips. Replace the short sword with ONE long broad straight two-handed steel GREATSWORD, grip long enough for both gauntlets. Anatomical RIGHT hand nearest the crossguard, anatomical LEFT hand nearer the pommel. Both hands stay on the same hilt in every melee pose. The entire sheet is three whole three-frame motion strips, reading left-to-right. TOP ROW = basic ATTACK: (1) compact loaded windup with weapon or fists held back, (2) forward committed strike at chest height, (3) recovery back to an upright ready stance. MIDDLE ROW = SMASH: (4) high overhead load with BOTH hands raised, (5) heavy descending overhead impact with deep bent knees, (6) recoil lifting back to neutral. BOTTOM ROW = SWEEP: (7) low coiled windup, (8) broad low horizontal sweeping strike with torso twist, (9) low follow-through recovering upright. For unarmed Herald make attack a straight right punch, smash a two-fist downward hammer, sweep a low sweeping right-leg kick with both fists guarding. All movement must be anatomically plausible; left and right arms do not swap between frames. Keep back mostly towards viewer with head looking screen right.
